people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
translations.bsb: “What did this people do to you,” Moses asked Aaron, “that you have led them into so great a sin?”
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin
translations.asv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought a great sin upon them?
